prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: production movement sprite sheet for a modern chibi pixel-art dog RPG.
Reference image 1 gives the existing dog identities and detailed pixel-art visual style. Reference image 2 gives ONLY the 4 by 4 movement-sheet layout and directional sequencing, not its poodle anatomy or fur. Create a new movement sheet for the specified breed only.
Canvas: exactly square, 1024 by 1024, a strict invisible 4 columns by 4 rows grid with 256 by 256 equal square cells. Exactly sixteen full-body dog sprites total, one centered per cell. The row-major cell centers are x=128,384,640,896 and y=128,384,640,896. Generous clear spacing. Same sprite scale and anchor in all cells; approximately 180 pixels tall, or 200 pixels wide in side view; keep all paws, ears, nose and full tail within each cell with at least 24 pixels clear padding.
Direction is critical: row 1 faces DOWN toward the viewer; row 2 faces LEFT; row 3 faces RIGHT; row 4 faces UP away from the viewer and shows the back of the head with no visible face.
Columns are four visibly different consecutive walk/run cycle phases: column 1 left forepaw reaching forward with opposite hind paw forward, column 2 passing step with paws under body and slight body lift, column 3 right forepaw reaching forward with opposite hind paw forward, column 4 opposite passing step with slight body lowering. Preserve these alternating paw positions in all four directions. Tail wags left-center-right-center across the four frames. Paws must articulate; never make four repeated still poses or merely shift the complete sprite.
Style: polished detailed chibi pixel art matching reference 1, cute large head and expressive eyes, compact quadruped anatomy, crisp stepped pixel edges and pixel-level fur clusters, fine dark pixel outlines, several warm shaded tones, slight top-down RPG camera angle. Maintain identical coat markings, face, body proportions and scale across all sixteen frames.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, with no painted background of any kind. No checkerboard, no floor, no ground shadow, no glow, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no borders, no extra dogs, no accessories.
Subject: ONE Shiba Inu dog identity repeated through the sixteen animation frames: tan-orange coat with cream muzzle, chest and paws, triangular upright ears, round dark eyes, fluffy curled tail with cream tip. Preserve the corresponding breed identity from reference image 1.
